fee_notes: Standard fee is $50,000; $35,000 for existing franchisees adding a unit; $25,000 (50% discount) for veterans and first responders. Multi-Unit Development Agreement fee is $125,000 for rights to open 3 locations (no additional Initial Franchise Fee per unit). Project Management Fee of $5,000 also required.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee is $50,000... We offer a reduced initial franchise fee of $25,000, a 50% discount, to veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces... During our last fiscal year, we collected Initial Franchise Fees ranging from $25,000 to $50,000.
